analysis: Examined BASE text of scripts/test-provider-ci-workflow.py (lines 1-799), an offline unittest that asserts properties of .github/workflows/ci.yml and the provider-ci-build composite action. The patch excerpt (head 155-187) adds constants for pinned checkout/cache actions and a SAVE_POLICY asserting caches are saved only on push to master/dev (pull requests never save), which appears stricter than the base policy where PRs could save when no cache was restored (base 714-717, 788-795). It also introduces a restored .git cache validated with git fsck --connectivity-only and discarded on failure (VALIDATE_GIT) plus sparse-checkout patterns. This file is test-only and does not itself change provider runtime, attestation, encryption, or prefix-cache (T-041) behavior. No threat-model asset is directly affected. Integration questions: the actual ci.yml/action.yml changes (not in this batch) should be checked to confirm (1) the .git cache restore cannot let a poisoned cache from a PR/untrusted ref influence checked-out source (fsck connectivity does not verify that HEAD matches the expected commit; confirm checkout still fetches and resets to github.sha), (2) cache keys for saved .git are scoped so PR runs cannot write, and (3) release-qualification/signed-artifact lanes (A-017, T-054) do not consume CI caches. Head-side test lines beyond the excerpt (792-923, 969-997) were not visible; their coverage is unverified.
